directions: Each item is one sentence whose parts have been jumbled and labelled P, Q, R and S. Rearrange them into the correct order (choose the sequence). Fragment boundaries are taken from the P/Q/R/S labels printed in the paper.
subs: P: its policy and announced reforms
Q: that the mounting tension was heading
R: the colonial Government, now seeing
S: towards a crisis, wisely decided to change
explanation: R+Q+S+P: ‘The colonial Government, now seeing / that the mounting tension was heading / towards a crisis, wisely decided to change / its policy and announced reforms.’
